content:
I am delighted to share that I have completed my judicial internship under Hon'ble Mr Justice Amit Mahajan, Judge, Delhi High Court. 

This internship was an incredibly enriching and insightful experience. I had the opportunity to work on a wide range of legal matters, particularly in industrial disputes, labour law, and land acquisition. My work involved conducting legal research on various cases and preparing case briefs, which gave me a deeper understanding of how legal arguments are structured and how courts approach complex questions of fact and law before a hearing. 

This experience significantly strengthened my research skills and gave me valuable insight into judicial reasoning and the adjudicatory process, especially in matters concerning labour rights and land law. 

I would also like to thank my co-interns, Eshant Kumar and Yojit Saini, for their collaboration and support throughout this journey, which made the experience all the more enjoyable and rewarding. 

I also want to thank the law researcher Vansh Vij, sir, for the constant guidance, patience, and willingness to teach us. The mentorship made this internship even more meaningful. 

I am deeply thankful to Hon'ble Justice Amit Mahajan, sir and the entire chamber for this incredible opportunity, and I look forward to carrying these learnings forward in my legal journey.
